title: Thunders of Emotions
description:
Aigaki tries to hide that he's an "electric person" who, when his emotions are excited, discharges "sparks" that can electrocute others. One day, he meets Manyo, a girl who is also hiding her identity as an "electric person"...? 

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)
